title: Lists 2.0: online lists get the same tidy page as device lists
blurb: An online list now opens with the same frame as a list on your device: the name is edited in place, one line says where the list stands, and the extra tools (Notify, Make Place import, auto-mark, recovery copy, leave and delete) sit behind a single More-options menu instead of a six-button bar and a settings drawer. The stats card and the separate filter row are gone; the estimate shows how many units you have acquired, and a Hide-acquired toggle now sits beside the cart's search box on both kinds of list. Activity history is still there, folded up below the cart.
